description: This file defines classes, structs, and functions related to the game status, time of day, player info, and game state management for the Battle for Wesnoth project.

classes.name: gamestatus
classes.description: Class managing the overall game status, including turn count and time of day.

classes.name: player_info
classes.description: Struct holding information about a player, such as gold, available units, and recruit options.

classes.name: game_state
classes.description: Struct representing the complete game state, including scenario, players, variables, and save data.

methods.name: gamestatus::write
methods.description: Serializes the game status to a config object.

methods.name: gamestatus::get_time_of_day
methods.description: Returns the current time of day object.

methods.name: gamestatus::next_turn
methods.description: Advances the game to the next turn, returning true if time has expired.

methods.name: game_state::get_player
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the specified player info by ID.
